en.t: I am not joking with you.

units.source_text: 不知道为什么，我看见她总觉得将来可能成为我的沉重包袱。

en.t: I do not know why, but whenever I see her I feel she may become a heavy burden to me someday.

units.source_text: 就说你吧，如果你喜欢她，好好观察观察她，你也会这样想的。”

en.t: Take yourself, for instance. If you liked her and watched her closely, you would think the same thing too.

units.source_text: 驹子把手搭在岛村的肩头上，依偎过去，突然摇摇头说：

en.t: Komako laid her hand on Shimamura's shoulder and leaned against him, then suddenly shook her head and said:

units.source_text: 要是碰上像你这样的人，也许她还不至于发疯呢。

en.t: If she met someone like you, maybe she would not have to go mad after all.
You carry this burden for me.
